0.heading: Overview
refs: 1Sa 4:1 , The Israelites are overcome by the Philistines at Ebenezer
1Sa 4:3 , They fetch the ark unto the terror of the Philistines
1Sa 4:10 , They are smitten again, the ark taken, and Hophni and Phinehas are slain
1Sa 4:12 , Eli at the news, falling backward, breaks his neck
1Sa 4:19 , Phinehas's wife, discouraged in her travail with I-chabod, dies.
